package.name: qar_qar_adapter
package.description: QarOS streaming C API adapter for qar_ogre_streaming. Implements the library's render-sender seam against the real QarOS runtime: session lifecycle, peer admission, app volumes, WGS84 geo-anchoring and per-frame OpenGL submission. The QarOS runtime is loaded dynamically at run time, so this package builds against the vendored header alone.
